CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.

3. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
